body.p: at the Phase 1 gate (PLAN.md: "substrate frozen at the Phase 1 gate"). Frozen: include/sxml/status.h, view.h, memory.h, string.h, name.h, types.h, tree.h, xdm.h (with export.h), as of the commit that records this, including . Not frozen: xml.h, processor.h, xpath.h, serialize.h, version.h (: they change through their design packets, and after packet only with a record, until release 0.2.0 makes them stable). Rule for a frozen header:

item.p: Any change, a comment that changes a contract included, needs a new decision record first that names the header, the change and the packet that needs it; implementation packets still write the need under "Proposed" and stop (CLAUDE.md).

Allowed with a record: new functions, new types, new enumeration constants at the end of an enumeration whose header says it only grows (built-in types, well-known namespaces, statuses), and new fields at the end of configuration and request structs whose zero value keeps the old behaviour. Not allowed without reopening this record: changing or removing a declaration, the meaning of an existing field or status, the 16-byte item and sequence layout (), node numbering (), or an operations table (interfaces are not extended in place: a new table type instead).
Comments that only fix wording or a citation need no record.
ABI: nothing is ABI-stable before release 0.2.0 (packet ); the freeze is about the design, so fields are still added at the end only.
